description:
Avengers had Doomsday. We have MOONSDAY! But instead of saving the universe, we're keeping the humans exploring it alive and healthy. 🚀

Houston, we have a health problem! And we're not waiting for an emergency transmission to solve it.

We're MOONSDAY, a team bringing AI, technology, and creativity together to monitor astronaut health and make space exploration safer.

Because exploring the Moon and universeis cool, but coming back healthy is cooler. 🌕
